citations.assessment: The Simon entry expressly repeats the contemporaneity notice. In Bamidbar Rabbah, Yochanan of Jaffa asks a question before Pinchas bar Chama in the name of Simon according to the received wording. This supports an attested connection and leaves the broader chronology qualified.

holds.reason: The named chain gives a connection with Simon. It does not date the two figures or establish a direct encounter between them.
